newsitem.title: USA: Camden Property, Paragon to merge.
newsitem.headline: Camden Property, Paragon to merge.

text.p: Camden Property Trust said on Monday it executed a definitive merger agreement with Paragon Group Inc, for Paragon to become a Camden subsidiary.
Camden said the deal would create the fourth-largest apartment REIT in the United States, with 36,199 units and total assets of over $1.25 billion.

Under the terms of the deal, each Paragon share would be exchanged for 0.64 shares of Camden, the company said. The ratio was based on Camden's closing price on December 4 of 27-3/4 per share and 17-3/4 for Paragon, it said.
Camden said if its stock price fell below $25.67 during a specific time frame, Paragon had the right to end the deal or Camden could increase the exchange ratio.
The merger, approved unanimously by both boards of directors, would combine Paragon's interest in 16,810 apartment units with Camden's 19,389 units, it said.
It was structured as a tax-free transaction and would be accounted for as a pooling of interest, it said.
Camden said it also expanded its board of directors to seven from five in connection with the merger. The deal was expected to close by April 1997, it said.
